versions.name: Space Exploration
versions.description: Fly a model rocket you built yourself, recover it and send it up again for a set objective, explain how engines push and satellites hold orbit, and design a sample-return mission or a crewed base off Earth.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
